{{Quote|The High Council finds Shigar Konshi unready for Jedi trials.|Nikil Nobil|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
'''Nikil Nobil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Alliance" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Nobil spoke with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]] via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] in order to convey the Council's decision that Konshi was unfit to undertake the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. When questioned as to why, Nobil lectured Konshi on his lack of self-control, citing his recent comments to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vuub]] as an example.<ref name="Alliance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nikil Nobil was mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] as a tie-in to the then-upcoming [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]]. Like many of the characters from the novel, which was written early in the game's development, Nobil has not been referenced in any other part of the game's multimedia project.<ref name="Alliance" />
